summary: Tested RBAC for 4 new Catálogos modules (Impresoras Fiscales, Servidores, Referentes, Productos para Integración). Backend: 9/10 pass. Catalog, migration (all profiles/users = none), Inactivo/Consulta 403s, profile ceiling, admin full access, quick-add fiscal printer by name and GET /referentes for non-admin all work. UI: /admin/profiles and /admin/users list the 4 new modules under Catálogos with Inactivo selected. Non-admin sidebar/redirect works at Inactivo. Consulta: page loads, no CRUD buttons, Servers save disabled, switches disabled. Edición Total Referentes: Nuevo/Editar/Eliminar/Fusionar visible, Edit and Delete work. FAIL: creating a referente (Nuevo Referente) returns 403 for an Edición Total user who lacks the special flag referentes:crear.

critical.issue: A user with referentes=edit (Edición Total) gets 403 'No tiene permiso para registrar nuevos referentes'. can_create_referente() only accepts admin or the special flag referentes:crear and ignores the module level. The UI shows 'Nuevo Referente' (canEdit) and then fails with an error toast.

minor.issue: include_inactive is honored only for role admin. A non-admin with Edición Total who inactivates a referente sees it disappear from the Referentes page and cannot reactivate it. The 'Todos'/inactive filter is useless for non-admins. Use has_module_level(user,'referentes','edit') instead of _is_admin.
Any authenticated user can still read these even at Inactivo. This is intentional so pickers keep working, but note there is no read gate (only productos-integracion has a read gate).

ui_bugs.issue: 'Nuevo Referente' is shown to Edición Total users, but saving fails with 403 (see backend critical).

issues: The sidebar puts the 4 new items between 'Bienes y Servicios' and 'Categoría Comercial'. The Perfiles/Usuarios grids list them after 'Tasa de Cambio'. Consider matching the order of MODULES to the sidebar.

action_items: backend/routes/referentes.py: in can_create_referente (or the POST /referentes handler), also allow has_module_level(user,'referentes','edit'), so Edición Total can create from the catalog page. Keep the referentes:crear flag for the Contacto Inicial 'Otro' path.
backend/routes/referentes.py list_referentes: honor include_inactive for users with referentes edit level, not only admin.
critical_code_review_comments: productos_integracion._require_admin checks role != admin again, which is redundant because has_module_level already handles admin. Harmless.
ProtectedRoute uses only localStorage permissions. Fine, the backend enforces too.
Migration in server.py skips users whose permissions field is not an object (3 legacy users with null permissions). They fall back to 'none', which is OK.
